title: Passwords hashed with unsalted MD5
impact: Any leak of the stored hashes yields plaintext passwords for most users.
description: hash_password() computes hashlib.md5(pw).hexdigest() with no salt and no work factor.
exploit_scenario: An attacker who obtains the hash store runs a GPU dictionary attack and recovers passwords in minutes.
preconditions: Read access to the stored hashes
category: Use of Password Hash With Insufficient Computational Effort
recommendation: Use argon2id/bcrypt/scrypt with a per-user salt.

title: Order lookup has no tenant/owner check (IDOR)
impact: Any caller can read every tenant's order records by enumerating ids.
description: get_order() selects by primary key only; routes.py passes the URL id straight through and there is no authentication on the route.
exploit_scenario: GET /api/orders/1, /2, /3 ... returns other tenants' orders including tenant_id and total.
recommendation: Derive the tenant from the session and add AND tenant_id = ? to the query.
snippet: cur.execute("SELECT id, tenant_id, total FROM orders WHERE id = ?", (order_id,))

title: Hard-coded AWS secret access key in settings.py
impact: Anyone with repository or artifact access holds live cloud credentials.
description: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY is a literal string in source.
exploit_scenario: Clone the repo, export the two variables, call the AWS API as the application identity.
recommendation: Rotate the key; load credentials from the environment or a secrets manager.

title: OS command injection via report format parameter
impact: Remote command execution as the web server user.
description: build_report() interpolates the request-derived fmt into an os.system() shell string.
exploit_scenario: GET /api/reports?format=pdf;id>/tmp/pwned runs id on the server.
recommendation: Allow-list fmt and call subprocess.run([...], shell=False).

title: Debug mode enabled in settings
impact: Verbose errors and the Werkzeug debugger may be exposed if this config reaches production.
exploit_scenario: Trigger an exception and read the stack trace / open the debugger console.
preconditions: Configuration deployed unchanged to a reachable host
recommendation: Default DEBUG to False and enable only via environment in local dev.
